description: This file contains Cucumber hook definitions (using @Before and @After annotations) to manage WebDriver lifecycle, including taking screenshots on failure and attaching them to reports.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Defines Cucumber hooks to initialize WebDriver before each scenario and to take a screenshot and clean up drivers after each scenario.

methods.name: beforeScenario
methods.description: Initializes the WebDriver before each test scenario.

methods.name: afterScenario
methods.description: Handles failure cleanup by taking screenshots and attaching them to reports, then quits the WebDriver.

methods.name: beforeScenario

methods.name: afterScenario
methods.description: Checks if the scenario failed; if so, takes a screenshot, attaches to reports, then quits the driver.
